title: Senior Technical Writer
jobDescription: At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. Job Description The Sr. Technical Writer with 3-6 years experience, will assist with the creation and maintenance of various types of documentation. This role includes writing, editing, and maintaining product and procedural documentation, as well as managing and updating the client documentation portal. In addition, the role involves planning, developing, and producing instructional and product-related video content, including screen recordings, walkthroughs, and multimedia tutorials to enhance user understanding and engagement. The candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise, written, and visual content. Key Job Functions/Responsibilities Plan, develop, organize, write, and translate product documentation in compliance with the company’s established guidelines and standards, within the requested deadlines. Collaborate with product managers and subject matter experts to gather project requirements, analyze documentation needs, and schedule realistic delivery timelines. Create and enhance visual content such as charts, graphics, and screen captures to clearly illustrate complex concepts. Develop documentation for multiple formats including print, online help systems, and digital platforms. Utilize MadCap Flare for authoring, editing, and publishing structured documentation. Design and develop video content, including storyboarding, scripting, and producing short instructional videos (e.g., 2-minute tutorials, product walkthroughs, and how-to demonstrations). Leverage AI-powered tools to improve content creation efficiency, including drafting, editing, summarization, visualization, and multimedia generation. Apply AI and automation techniques to streamline documentation workflows, improve content consistency, and drive process improvements across the documentation lifecycle. Provide writing, editing, and design support to other team members to ensure high-quality deliverables. Continuously identify and implement innovative ways to deliver effective, user-friendly documentation and multimedia content to customers. Basic Skill Level Requirements Education Bachelor’s Degree in Technical Writing, English, Journalism, or another writing-related or Information Systems/Computing-related subject. Alternatively, comparable training in Technical Writing with several years’ experience. Technical Skills/Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Expertise in MadCap Flare, Canva, and Camtasia. Experience in technical design, layout, and production concepts and practices. Understanding topic-based writing and ability to write in explanatory and procedural styles. Strong research, analytical, and writing skills. Strong project management skill is an asset. Skilled at prioritization and multi-tasking. A successful candidate must be a reliable team player able to effectively manage multiple deadlines with minimal supervision. Software Requirements Proficient in MadCap Flare, Canva, and Camtasia. Knowledge of XML, HTML, and CSS. Knowledge of version control system (GitLab, SVN). Knowledge of SnagIt, MadCap Capture, PaintShop Pro or similar screen capture applications. Knowledge of MadCap Mimic, Adobe Captivate, or similar program is a plus. Proficient in Microsoft Office suite including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio. title: QA Engineer
jobDescription: At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. Role Overview The QA Engineer is a quality-focused individual with solid technical expertise in testing and validating trading platform solutions for our clients. In this role, you will ensure the quality and reliability of Broadridge trading systems for high-touch and low-touch Agency trading desks through comprehensive testing strategies, within the context of client delivery projects. This position will lead to a deeper understanding of international financial markets and to an excellent knowledge of our product suite. Within the Professional Services department, you will drive quality assurance across client platform implementations following the Agile methodology. Responsibilities Work with project managers, client product specialists, implementation engineers, technical architects, and technical leads in squads to define and execute testing strategies, and report on quality metrics and testing progress to clients and internal stakeholders; Work with our clients to analyse their requirements and issues from a business, functional, and technical perspective to design appropriate test plans and test cases; Assist project managers in estimating and sizing QA effort within project timelines; Design, develop, and execute functional, regression, integration, and performance test cases for trading platform configurations and customizations; Identify, document, and track defects through their full lifecycle, collaborating with implementation engineers, client teams and customer support teams for timely resolution; Build and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks to support continuous testing practices across delivery pipelines; Provide quality status reporting and sign-off recommendations to stakeholders ahead of go-live milestones and production deployments; Liaise with our client’s product team, Engineering, and our Technical Account Managers to align on quality standards and coverage expectations; Proactively improve testing processes to promote better quality and safer deployments; Enhance your business and technical knowledge of international financial markets relating to principal and agency trading, equities and derivatives, FX, and fixed income asset classes; and develop your understanding of Broadridge products which serve these businesses; Champion a test-driven methodology across the delivery team. Your profile University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Science, or equivalent; Experience in the finance industry is a must have, such as in high-touch and low-touch agency trading systems, market connectivity, and/or asset classes such as equities, derivatives, structured products, FX, and fixed income; 2-5 years of experience in QA, testing, or related roles; Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies, including test planning, test case design, and defect lifecycle management; Experience with test automation frameworks (e.g. Selenium, pytest, or equivalent); FIX and other exchange protocol knowledge is a must have; Source control systems (Git); Programming experience is a plus; Experience in a client-facing technical support role or an implementation/delivery role; Excellent communication skills, including fluent written and oral English; Autonomy, organization, and a strong sense of accountability; Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
